sources.name: OpenRouter models (with Artificial Analysis and Design Arena)
sources.measures: Model catalog, prices and context windows; Artificial Analysis intelligence, coding and agentic indices; Design Arena ratings for websites, UI components and web apps (frontend).

sources.name: Terminal-Bench 4.0
sources.measures: Long tasks in a terminal: building, configuring, debugging systems (deployment and configuration). Rows name the agent, so it also measures agents.

sources.name: SWE-Bench Pro V2
sources.measures: Long, multi-file changes in professional codebases (backend). The hard subset separates strong models; rows name the agent.

sources.name: SWE-rebench
sources.measures: Fresh GitHub issues collected after each model's release, in one harness (backend, debugging); its TypeScript tasks inform frontend.

sources.name: SWE-bench Verified and Multilingual
sources.measures: Fixing real GitHub issues (backend, debugging). Verified anchors KM0's ability scale and, through its human time estimates, the difficulty of tasks.

sources.name: Aider Polyglot
sources.measures: Small coding exercises in six languages, edited through Aider (general coding; older models only).
